scope: 50-record local candidate index plus live full-corpus retrieval variants. No production promotion.

generation.price_basis: Cloudflare published input/output token rates, not invoice attribution. Other providers, failures, embedding and search costs excluded.

owner_viewpoint_comparison.limitation: Coarse aerial/ground agreement does not validate nadir versus oblique, objects, OCR or caption accuracy.

traffic.limitation: Scripted pilot mix, not production load or browser end-to-end latency. API cache state unknown.

comparisons.filter_note: Only pilot-enriched candidates can satisfy constraints. Unsupported or unknown abstains. Offline feature eligibility is not human verification.
